title: They Devoted Themselves
question: What did the very first church actually do together?
blurb: Four habits, listed plainly. Trace what grew out of them in the verses that follow.

nodes.content: What did the very first church actually do together?

nodes.verseText: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
All the believers were together and had everything in common.
With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.
Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
